name: Aegis Site X-ray
description: Passive security posture inspector reviewing HTTP response headers and security attributes.
notes: Permission justification: webRequest (non-blocking) and <all_urls> are required to passively observe response headers (Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, Set-Cookie flags) across visited websites without modifying or blocking traffic (webRequestBlocking is not requested). tabs is used to associate posture reports with the active tab. storage is used for kill-switch persistence. Operates strictly offline with zero external network communication (Privacy Class P0).
